chapterInfo.content:
19
Odiyifoɔ Yehu ka Ɔhene Yehosafat anim
1Na Yudahene Yehosafat sane baa ne fie asomdwoeɛ mu wɔ Yerusalem. 2Na Hanani ba Yehu, ɔdehunufoɔ no, firi kɔhyiaa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Ɔhene Yehosafat sɛ: Ɔbɔnefoɔ na ɛsɛ sɛ woboa no, na wɔn a wɔtane AWURADE no na wodɔ wɔn? Na yei nti abufuo a ɛfiri AWURADE anim da wo so. 3#2 Be 17.3-6 Nanso wɔahunu wo ho nsɛm pa, sɛ woatwitwa Asera nnua afiri asase no so, na woasiesie w’akoma ahwehwɛ Onyankopɔn.
4Na Yehosafat tenaa Yerusalem. Na ɔsane firi kɔɔ ɔman no mu de firii Beer-seba kɔsii Efraim bepɔ so, na ɔdanee wɔ sane baa AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn no nkyɛn.
Asennie ho nhyehyɛɛ foforɔ
5Na ɔsisii atemmufoɔ asase no so, Yuda nkuro a ɛyɛ den nyinaa mu mmaako mmaako. 6Na ɔka kyerɛɛ atemmufoɔ no sɛ: Monhwɛ deɛ moreyɛ yie, na ɛnyɛ onipa na morebu atɛn ama no, na mmom AWURADE, na ɔne mo wɔ hɔ atemmuo asɛm no mu. 7#Eks 18.21; Deut 10.17 Na afei AWURADE ho suro ntena mo so. Monhwɛ yie na monyɛ, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn no, nkontompo ne animhwɛ ne kɛtɛ-asehyɛ nni ne fam.
8 # Deut 17.8-9; 19.17 Na Yerusalem nso, Yehosafat de Lewifoɔ ne asɔfoɔ ne Israel agyanom atitire no mu binom sisii AWURADE atemmuo ne asennie so. Na wɔn atenaeɛ ne Yerusalem. 9Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sei na monyɛ wɔ AWURADE ho suro mu, nokorɛ ne mo akoma mu. 10Asɛm biara a ɛba mo anim a ɛfiri mo nuanom a wɔtete wɔn nkuro mu, na ɛyɛ mogya ne mogya ntam asɛm, anaa mmara ne ɛmom, ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmuo ntam asɛm no, monkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mu, na wɔanni fɔ wɔ AWURADE anim, na abufuo amma mo ne mo nuanom so; monyɛ saa, na morenni fɔ. 11Na hwɛ, Ɔsɔfoɔ Amaria na ɔda mo ano, AWURADE nsɛm nyinaa fam, na Ismael ba Sebadia a ɔyɛ Yuda fie bapɔmma no nso, ɔhene nsɛm nyinaa fam, na atemmufoɔ Lewifoɔ no nso wɔ mo anim. Mo ho nyɛ den na monyɛ, na AWURADE ne apapafoɔ bɛtena.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
